verdict: Lead volume dropped sharply this week; creative refresh is already underway.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 99 leads at an average cost of $7.46 per lead — a solid baseline. However, in the most recent 7 days lead volume fell 44.83% on nearly flat spend, pushing the current cost per lead to roughly $13.70, nearly double the period average. The pattern points to creative fatigue on Meta, the sole active ad channel: the same audiences have seen the same ads long enough that response has dropped off sharply. Ad creative for the top retargeting campaign is being refreshed this week to stabilise volume. Separately, 102 opportunities entered your pipeline this period but none converted to booked appointments, which points to a gap in the intake process rather than the ads — that is being reviewed in parallel so leads that do arrive are not lost.
